title: 3-bit R-2R ladder
description: Build a 3-bit R-2R resistor ladder DAC. The bit inputs are fixed voltage sources that must appear exactly: 'Vb2 b2 0 DC 5' (MSB), 'Vb1 b1 0 DC 0', 'Vb0 b0 0 DC 5' (LSB), i.e. the input code is 101. The ladder output node must be named 'vout' and must equal 5V * 5/8 = 3.125V +/-1%. Use only resistors besides the three sources. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
